widget.description: Complete navigation (in-dashboard page navigation) widget definition for create or full replacement. Omitted fields are dropped on replacement. parameters.navigationItems is the ordered list of destinations; an omitted or empty list is an empty nav bar. Upsert defines the widget only; it neither places it nor changes existing placements. This is a gated pilot type: persisting the batch or using save_dashboard fails with ACCESS_DENIED unless the org has the navigation-widget pilot enabled.

id.description: Existing widget ID. Required when fully replacing a persisted widget; omit when creating a widget. Never invent this value. An unsaved draft widget has no ID and may be replaced by matching widget.name.

name.description: Stable widget key, e.g. "navigation_1". On persisted replacement, it must match the widget identified by id.

actions.description: Optional click/select interactions. Full per-type shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

dynamicTokens.description: Optional dynamic value bindings keyed by token name. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

order.description: Explicit position in the navigation order.

defaultStyle.description: ButtonStyle applied to unselected items. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/styleBlocks/ButtonStyle.

selectedStyle.description: ButtonStyle applied to the selected item. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/styleBlocks/ButtonStyle.

dropdownValueStyle.description: WidgetTextStyle for a dropdown-rendered viewType. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/styleBlocks/WidgetTextStyle.
